# University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa

> The primary admissions and institutional information hub for UH Mānoa, Hawaii's flagship public research university.

UH Mānoa serves as the main campus of the University of Hawaiʻi system, located in Honolulu. This site provides comprehensive resources for prospective students, families, and the campus community, with emphasis on undergraduate and graduate admissions, institutional research, and Native Hawaiian advancement initiatives.

## Key Topics

- Undergraduate Admissions
- Graduate Admissions
- International Students
- Native Hawaiian Education
- Faculty and Staff Directory
- Enrollment Process
- Campus Resources
- Parent Guide
- Institutional Research
- Student Support Services
- College Exploration
- Admitted Students
- Freshman Orientation
- Department Lookup
- Rainbow Warrior

## Admissions & Enrollment

- [Undergraduate Admissions](https://manoa.hawaii.edu/admissions): Main undergraduate admissions page for UH Manoa with programs and campus info
- [Graduate Admissions](https://manoa.hawaii.edu/graduate/prospective-students): Graduate admissions guide with application process and cost of attendance info
- [International Undergraduate Admissions](https://manoa.hawaii.edu/admissions/international/index.html): International undergraduate admissions requirements and English proficiency guidelines
- [Parent Guide for Undergraduate Admissions](https://manoa.hawaii.edu/admissions/parents.html): Parent guide for undergraduate admissions and enrollment at UH Manoa

## Student Support & Services

- [campusHELP Student Support](https://manoa.hawaii.edu/crsc): campusHELP student support service for campus-related questions and concerns
- [Faculty and Staff Directory](https://manoa.hawaii.edu/directory): Faculty and staff directory search tool for UH Manoa

## Institutional & Research

- [Mānoa Institutional Research Office](https://manoa.hawaii.edu/miro): Institutional research office providing enrollment, rankings, and effectiveness data
- [Native Hawaiian Place of Learning Advancement Office](https://manoa.hawaii.edu/nhpol): Native Hawaiian Place of Learning Advancement Office advancing UH Manoa's institutional mission
